taste:
The main contrast is crisp golden batter against tender, flaky white cod. A smaller fillet keeps the serving manageable without changing that familiar combination of crunchy coating and soft fish. This is still a traditional battered cod meal, rather than a different style of fish dish chosen simply because you want less food.

Thick-cut chips come in a modest portion, with mushy or garden peas alongside. The choice of peas gives you some control over the accompaniment while keeping the plate straightforward. For a lighter appetite at lunch or early evening, the appeal is the familiar fish-and-chips texture in a smaller serving, not a promise of lower calories.
value:
At a typical {price}, the value depends on how well the smaller portion matches your appetite. Its price position is {pricePosition}, although prices vary by pub. Choose it for a manageable serving rather than assuming it is the cheapest fish option.

Freshly Battered Cod and Chips is the comparison to make if portion size matters most. Small Whitby Breaded Scampi offers another small option in the same section, but it is a different dish. Fish Friday pricing is noted for Fridays; check the price at your chosen pub before ordering.

Check that the information matches your choice of mushy or garden peas and covers the complete plate. If you add sides, sauces or a drink, consult their nutrition information too rather than treating the dish figure as the total for everything you order.
dietaryGuidance:
Small Battered Cod and Chips contains fish and is not suitable for vegetarian or vegan diets. No dietary tags are recorded for this dish in our data, so there is no basis for recommending it for a specialist diet.

The listed allergens are cereals containing gluten, eggs and fish. Anyone avoiding these should check Wetherspoon’s current [allergen information](/allergen-information) and speak to the pub before ordering. Swaps or additions can change the allergens in the meal, so do not assume an altered plate has the same allergen profile.
